messages:
Anya: Morning — async standup check. KMS rotation dry-run ran overnight. Most keys rotated ok but the db-keystore rotation failed due to a permission error when the rotator assumed the role. Blocker: need iam-admin approval to allow iam:PassRole for the rotator service account. Plan: I'll open a narrowly scoped PR and ping @Mike for review, target staging rollout after approval.

Mike: can you paste the failing log lines so I can see the exact error?

Anya: here are the error lines from the job log:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:08Z Rotator ERROR: AssumeRole failed: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/rotator-role/service not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/db-keystore-rotation
	status=403 code=AccessDenied
```

Mike: yup looks like missing iam:PassRole on that specific role. I can approve a PR that scopes permission to that role ARN only — please make sure it doesn't widen scope.

Rachel: quick question — customer impact? tagging @sre-lucas

sre-lucas: no customer-facing outages. The rotation job retried and backlog is small. This is internal only.

deploy-bot: rotation-dryrun report: 23/24 keys rotated successfully, 1 failed (db-keystore). Full report: https://internal.reports/rotations/4132109876

Josh: i'll pick up the PR once Anya opens it and do a quick CR after Mike signs off. FYI I pushed a small change to the test harness to lower concurrency (should reduce KMS throttles in staging).

Mike: I can review within the hour, no objections to scope as long as it's role-limited. :thumbsup:

Anya: opening PR now -> https://stash/repo/pull/4821. PR description includes exact policy diff and validation steps. Will ping Mike and merge after approval. Targeting staging rollout at 10:30 PT if green. :eyes:

Rachel: sounds good. also starting a compliance doc update for rotation evidence and will link the doc to the PR for audit trail.

Anya: awesome — thanks all. If anyone sees anything else in the logs please flag here. I'll follow up post-rollout with results.
